items.stem: Why can an FPGA implement many independent operations that all run at the same time?

options.text: Its logic is spatial hardware, so separate circuits operate concurrently
options.rationale: Correct: FPGA logic is parallel hardware, not sequential instructions.

options.text: It has an extremely high clock speed
options.rationale: Concurrency comes from spatial parallelism, not just clock speed.

options.text: It runs a multithreaded operating system
options.rationale: An FPGA fabric is not running an operating system.

options.text: It compiles HDL into fast machine code
options.rationale: HDL is synthesised into hardware, not into machine code.

items.explanation: Correct: FPGA logic is parallel hardware, not sequential instructions.

items.stem: Which TWO steps in the FPGA design flow convert HDL into a configuration the device can load? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Synthesis, which maps HDL to logic primitives
options.rationale: Correct: synthesis translates RTL into gates and LUT/flip-flop primitives.

options.text: Place-and-route, which assigns and connects those primitives on the fabric
options.rationale: Correct: place-and-route produces the physical implementation leading to the bitstream.

options.text: Running the HDL on the host CPU
options.rationale: HDL is not executed on the CPU to program the device.
FPGAs load a bitstream, not a C firmware image.

items.explanation: Correct: synthesis translates RTL into gates and LUT/flip-flop primitives.

items.stem: A design fails to meet its 100 MHz timing target after place-and-route. What is the most appropriate first response?

options.text: Examine the critical path and apply or tighten timing constraints and pipelining
options.rationale: Correct: analysing the critical path and adding constraints/pipelining addresses timing.

options.text: Increase the supply voltage until it passes
options.rationale: Raising voltage is not a sound or safe first design response.

options.text: Remove the testbench to speed up the tool
options.rationale: Removing verification does not fix timing and is risky.
The file extension has no effect on timing closure.

items.explanation: Correct: analysing the critical path and adding constraints/pipelining addresses timing.
